title: Prepress Operator — Career Roadmap
summary: A Prepress Operator prepares digital artwork for printing by checking files, arranging pages, correcting colours, creating print-ready PDFs, preparing plates or production files, and ensuring designs meet printing specifications.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Printing Technology / Packaging Technology

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 followed by a Printing Technology diploma; Class 12 and design-related pathways may also be suitable.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Computer Applications, Mathematics, English, Art and Graphic Design.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: State polytechnic admission tests or institution-specific admissions, where applicable.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Typography, page layout, colour separation, image resolution, imposition and packaging artwork.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Attention to detail, file organisation, visual accuracy and computer proficiency.

items.text: Diploma in Printing Technology → Prepress workflow, print production, colour separation and plate preparation.
Diploma in Printing & Packaging Technology → Packaging artwork, labels, cartons and print-ready production files.
Diploma in Graphic Design → Layout, typography, image editing and artwork preparation.
Diploma in Multimedia / Digital Design → Digital assets, image processing and production graphics.
Certificate in Desktop Publishing (DTP) → Page layout, typesetting and document preparation.

blocks.text: For a dedicated Prepress Operator role, combine design-software skills with printing-process knowledge and practical prepress workflow training.
